item: The backup export is one server-side job that survives a page reload
key_paths: src/backup/export_job.py; src/backup/export_folder.py; src/backup/merge.py; src/api/backup_v2.py; src/static/app-backup.js; src/static/app-core.js; src/api/jobs.py; src/backup/restore_marker.py; tests/test_export_job.py
summary: The export dialog used to chain the corpus volumes and the large-data copy from the browser, so a reload between them left the copy unstarted. ExportJobManager (a BackgroundJob kind, not a writer) now allocates the dated folder, runs the volume job, applies the done/backup/same-folder gate server-side (a failed gate ends the export 'failed' with a named reason and never starts the copy) and then runs the folder job; the page starts it and polls /api/backup/export/status and re-attaches after a reload. The passphrase is held only until the volumes phase starts and never reaches the record, the status or a log. oo-export-request.json carries the phase and is the resume cursor: pause and resume in either phase stay in one folder, the corpus phase asks for the passphrase again, and after a restart the panel offers Resume export. A restore refuses while an export runs and names it (R712); stop_all_jobs asks it to pause (R689) -- the large-data copy stops between files, but the corpus phase pauses only between volumes, so stop_all may report backup-export still running at its deadline; nothing more is written after the pause lands, and the record keeps the phase; the old volume and folder start routes stay for the advanced panel (R713). Review fixes before merge: the folder is remembered as soon as the server names it; one watcher per dialog and one completion per export; a slow stop reads 'stopping' and stays live (R712 holds) instead of failing at 60 s, and a dying worker never leaves it running; a manager's error is passed unprefixed with error_phase beside it and the export's own sentences are translated whole; record categories are filtered on read; the gate also checks the job's started_at; an export refuses to start or resume while a restore runs; Copy the large-data files now finishes a done or cancelled folder; a paused export can be cancelled and shows as paused in the task manager. Security and correctness re-reads: the record is rewritten from known keys through an exclusive, no-follow temp file (a planted .oopart link is never written through); every restore path (single-file, volume, folder, the import queue) holds one shared restore marker that export start and resume check under its lock; a large-data import is refused, naming the export, for the whole export (Plan's R712 ruling); a stopping export re-attaches on reopen; a refused resume shows its reason; a failed or paused export can be cancelled from its record, also after a restart; a stop after the phase boundary never starts the copy. Strings x12. Release line: a backup export now finishes on its own even if you close or reload the page, and a paused or interrupted export can be resumed into the same folder.
